snippet.title: Tenancy Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4696940/Tenancy/
Original music by Harry King

Tenancy is a rougelike deckbuilder about managing the costs, risks, and unique effects of angry little ladies to live off their paychecks. While tenants may be lackluster on their own, when played together they can be extorted for maximum value! Everything has something to shine alongside. It's just up to you to put the pieces together before the bills catch up.
